given_when_then.given: The Order Allocation Engine receives an Order Request containing multiple items
given_when_then.when: The system checks the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for the selected Store Partner
given_when_then.then: The system validates that the available quantity for every item is greater than or equal to the requested quantity

given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request where no Store Partner has sufficient stock for all items
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: The Order Allocation Engine receives an Order Request where multiple Store Partners have sufficient stock
given_when_then.when: The system calculates estimated preparation and dispatch time for each eligible store
given_when_then.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time

given_when_then.given: The system completes a successful order assignment to a Store Partner
given_when_then.then: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot is immediately updated with deducted quantities for all items in the Order Request

given_when_then.given: The Order Allocation Engine processes an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicates sufficient stock for all items at a Store Partner
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Fulfillment Task for the assigned order

success_criteria: The system successfully assigns an Order Request to a Store Partner only when the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.
The system flags an Order Request for manual review when no Store Partner has sufficient inventory for the complete order.
The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time.
The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot is immediately updated with deducted quantities upon successful automatic assignment to prevent overselling.
The system does not create a Fulfillment Task when an Order Request cannot be assigned due to insufficient inventory.
The system validates all items in an Order Request against the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot of the selected Store Partner before assignment.
